integrity: Analytical Schur-complement and chi-square proof supplemented by reproducible finite-dimensional checks; no independent scientific audit or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: One exact rank-deficient consistent linear least-squares solve with orthonormal-row Jacobian and an iid standard Gaussian variable subspace; no nonlinear Gauss–Newton convergence, safeguards, noisy observations, non-Gaussian sketches, or finite-precision claims. title: Exact nullspace inflation for Gaussian reduced least-squares pseudoinverses
